title: Pitched notes keep the track's static filter even when the filter is automated
description: Spotted by the resonant-filter agent (apricitus-a82e91). In crates/apricity-score/src/compile.rs, the pitched note-generation path (around line 2087, pitched_events) copies the track's static FilterSpec onto every Event without checking for a filter automation lane. The sibling path (around line 2011) clears the per-note filter when the track automates filter. So a pitched track (voicing or notes) with 'filter lp 20000' and 'automate filter ...' gets the per-note static filter and the stem-level sweep, filtering twice. Fix: apply the same rule in pitched_events. Test: a pitched track with a filter lane has filter: None on its events.
